items.title: Partnering with Axios expands OpenAI’s work with the news industry
items.summary: Publishers representing hundreds of newsrooms and content brands are using OpenAI partnerships and grant programs to adopt AI tools and strengthen the news ecosystem, while ChatGPT users gain access to information from leading, reliable publications.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布与Axios建立合作伙伴关系，允许ChatGPT用户访问权威新闻内容，并扩大新闻机构对AI工具的应用。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与Axios达成合作，扩展了其在新闻出版行业的布局与合规合作。
